reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Great mask! It feels soothing and refreshing on the skin. My teenage daughter also really liked it. I would buy it again.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅面膜！用喺皮膚上感覺舒緩又清爽。我個十幾歲嘅女都好鍾意。我會再買。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: First time using SOME BY MI masks! The sheet is soft and stays perfectly on the face. I purchased a few different functional types, and Cica was definitely the best fit for my skin.
reviews.zh: 第一次用 SOME BY MI 嘅面膜！面膜紙好柔軟，貼住面好服貼。我買咗幾款唔同功能嘅，Cica 嗰款絕對最啱我嘅皮膚。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Great if you have really sensitive skin, it’s very soothing and cooling. My skin is super sensitive to breakouts and didn’t react to the mask. 10/10
reviews.zh: 如果你係敏感肌就啱用，佢好舒緩、好涼爽。我嘅皮膚超容易爆瘡，用咗都冇反應。10/10

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: Маски очень успокаивают кожу. Хорошо питает с приятным запахом. Идеально для проблемной кожи.
reviews.zh: 呢款面膜非常舒緩皮膚。氣味怡人，滋潤度夠。最啱有肌膚問題嘅人用。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: These masks from SOME BY MI are great. I got them in a sale so they were even better value, and I like that there are many options for different types of skin. My skin concerns depend on the time of year, so this is great for me to be able to buy individual masks at lower cost
reviews.zh: SOME BY MI 嘅呢啲面膜好好用。趁減價買，CP值更加高，而且我好鍾意佢有好多唔同選擇畀唔同膚質。因為我嘅皮膚問題會跟住季節變，所以可以平價單獨買到唔同款式，對我嚟講真係好方便。

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: It smells normal but not very good
reviews.zh: 味道一般，而且唔算好聞

reviews.shade: SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet 1P
reviews.text: I really love the SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care Mask Sheet! It instantly soothes my skin and helps reduce redness and irritation while providing deep hydration. The mask feels gentle and refreshing, leaving my face soft, calm, and balanced after use. It’s perfect for sensitive or stressed skin days. 🌿✨
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意 SOME BY MI Real Cica Calming Care 面膜！佢可以即刻舒緩我嘅皮膚，幫助退紅同減少刺激，同時做到深層保濕。面膜用落感覺溫和清爽，用完之後成塊面變得柔軟、平靜、平衡。皮膚敏感或者受壓嘅日子用就最啱。🌿✨
